scope.result_counts: Sums of test-result lines within exact logged command-group boundaries; not deduplicated unique cases. Separate parameter-entry and generated-Rust compatibility commands are not included in full-workspace totals.
scope.package_counts: cargo package verifies packages by compiling them; zero test-result lines does not imply packages were unverified. The step status and complete output are retained.
scope.source: Every executed checkout log names the same Git merge commit. Its tree equals the PR head tree. The separate frozen local-source-parity record compares 630 source blobs to the successful local run.
scope.toolchains: Rust version observations are preserved as exact log lines. Stable CI is distinct from the local Ohm run; fuzz smoke uses nightly.
scope.artifacts: GitHub artifact metadata and server-provided digests are retained. Artifact archives were not downloaded or independently verified for this CI supplement.
scope.excluded: No macOS, no new uv/ty application build, and no scheduled sustained fuzz campaign. The campaign job is skipped. Existing fixed-Git uv/ty evidence remains separate.
